subject.title: [Feature]: Native-looking Mac pairing approval dialog with instant Approve/Reject

question: Should macOS pairing cards disappear immediately after Approve/Reject, with failed or still-pending requests restored asynchronously?
rationale: This trades faster perceived response for temporarily hiding a security-sensitive request before the authoritative Gateway result is known, so the permanent interaction contract requires maintainer UX and trust-boundary intent.

options.title: Adopt optimistic dismissal
options.body: Land the linked approach after proving authoritative reconciliation, card restoration, and truthful failure feedback in a real macOS session.

options.title: Keep synchronous cards
options.body: Use native dialog chrome but retain the card until the Gateway confirms the decision, avoiding provisional disappearance at the cost of remote-gateway latency.

options.title: Show immediate pending state
options.body: Replace dimmed blocking behavior with an immediate native progress transition while keeping the request visible until authoritative resolution.

recommendation.title: Adopt optimistic dismissal
recommendation.body: Land the linked approach after proving authoritative reconciliation, card restoration, and truthful failure feedback in a real macOS session.
